tools.name: find_sun_times
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a golden hour calculator, golden hour time, sunrise sunset times, sunset time today, what time is golden hour, blue hour, sunrise time, or twilight times for a city and local date. Returns local sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, twilight, light windows and sun

tools.name: plan_golden_hour_shoot
tools.description: Use this when the user wants photography golden hour shoot windows for a city and a date range, with an ICS calendar file and CSV table. Choose morning, evening or both. Limits: 1–31 days, cities with population 50,000+ (plus Tromso), years 1900–2100, flat sea-level horizon; missing polar windows ar

tools.name: compare_day_length
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for day length differences and average change per day between two local dates, or the solstices and equinoxes of a year. Returns daylight duration for each date and signed changes. Limits: cities with population 50,000+ (plus Tromso), dates/years 1900–2100, flat sea-level
